mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ShareeInSameTeam removes the constraint that sharedWith users must be in the same team as the task. The injected violation forces a cross-team user into sharedWith, which both NoInformationLeakage and FR_012_CrossTeamSharingForbidden assert must be impossible.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShareViolation { some t: Task | some u: User | u.userTeam != t.taskTeam and u in t.sharedWith }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OwnerOnlyShareControl removes the restriction that only task owners may author shared/unshared audit events. The injected violation forces a non-owner actor to author an OpShared entry, which FR_010_OwnerOnlyShareControl and OwnershipBasedAccess must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonOwnerShareAuditViolation { some e: AuditEntry | e.entryOp = OpShared and e.entryActor != e.entryTask.taskOwner }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries removes the constraint that OpDeleted is terminal and unique. The injected violation forces two distinct OpDeleted entries for the same task, representing a re-written audit record — exactly what AppendOnly is supposed to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateDeletedViolation { some disj e1, e2: AuditEntry | e1.entryTask = e2.entryTask and e1.entryOp = OpDeleted and e2.entryOp = OpDeleted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditActorRoleSnapshot allows an audit entry to record a role that does not match the actor's actual role. The injected violation forces a mismatch, which AttributionCorrectness asserts must not occur.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleMismatchViolation { some e: AuditEntry | e.entryActor.userRole = Member and e.entryActorRole = TeamAdmin }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CrossTeamIsolation removes the constraint that audit actors must be in the same team as the task. The injected violation forces a cross-team actor to appear in an audit entry, which NoInformationLeakage and FR_006_CrossTeamAbsoluteIsolation both assert is impossible.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamActorViolation { some e: AuditEntry | e.entryActor.userTeam != e.entryTask.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ShareeCannotDelete removes the restriction that only owners and admins may author OpDeleted audit events. The injected violation forces a sharee (non-owner, non-admin, in-team member present in sharedWith) to author a deleted event, which FR_011_ShareeCannotDelete must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ShareeDeleteViolation { some e: AuditEntry | some t: Task | e.entryTask = t and e.entryOp = OpDeleted and e.entryActor != t.taskOwner and e.entryActor.userRole = Member and e.entryActor in t.sharedWith }
